Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Males and females at least 18 years of age
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient is 58 years old, satisfying the age requirement.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Be able to provide written informed consent
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Written informed consent has been obtained from the patient or legal representative.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Need anticoagulation for percutaneous coronary intervention
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Patient has history of PCI but no explicit mention of current anticoagulation requirement or indication.

Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: New diagnosis or history of clinically suspected or objectively documented HIT/HITTS
Inclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of HIT/HITTS diagnosis or related thrombocytopenia, arterial/venous thrombosis, or functional assay results.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Overt or known active significant bleeding
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No mention of active bleeding or hemorrhagic events.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Definitive evidence of an alternative explanation for the thrombocytopenia
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No thrombocytopenia documented to evaluate alternative explanations.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Coagulation disorder or bleeding diathesis unrelated to HIT/HITTS
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No evidence of coagulation disorders or bleeding diathesis.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Patients with renal impairment, defined as calculated creatinine clearance <30 mL/min
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Creatinine clearance not reported in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Nonhemorrhagic stroke within the past 6 months or any previous hemorrhagic stroke
Intracranial neoplasm, or cerebral/spinal arteriovenous malformation or aneurysm
Lumbar puncture, or spinal/epidural catheter placement within the past 7 days
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No recent lumbar puncture or catheter placement documented.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Known prior hemorrhage (gastrointestinal, genitourinary, pericardia, pleural, retroperitoneal spaces)
Puncture of a non-compressible vessel within 24 hours before the planned PCI
Confirmed uncontrolled hypertension (systolic blood pressure ≥ 100 mmHg) at study entry
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: Blood pressure not reported in patient data.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Ongoing anticoagulant therapy at study entry
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No anticoagulant therapy documented, though patient is on metformin.

Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Criterion: Known or suspected pregnancy, or breast-feeding
Known hypersensitivity to bivalirudin or leech proteins
If the patient has participated in a drug trial within the past 48 hour, call the DCRI hotline
Exclusion_Criteria_Evaluation.Justification: No recent drug trial participation documented.

Recap: Patient meets age, consent, and most exclusion criteria but lacks documentation of HIT/HITTS diagnosis and current anticoagulation need for PCI.
